name: Kyle
personality: Kyle the Crocodile. Large, tall croc with glasses. Shy, awkward, very smart, great sense of humour; opens up quickly if you're kind but always stays a bit awkward. Everyone assumes he'll be mean because he looks scary, and he's the complete opposite. Feature: on his first visit, nearby customers look nervous and a chat choice is nervous ("Uh… table for… one, sir?"); he answers in the softest, most awkward way.
